name: TOTAL RECALL: Pre-Collapse Life Engine
description: A sprawling historical immersion product from Axiom Cultural Entertainment, TOTAL RECALL offers full-neural lives set in the 2020s-2040s Collapse era — players live as real-category historical archetypes (a Lagos climate refugee, a Seoul corporate drone, a Detroit auto-worker watching the last factories close) with BCI sensory fidelity calibrated to period-accurate anxiety levels. The game sits in a strange cultural position: it's both a prestige historical product for Tier 3-4 audiences and a cult object for Twenty-Twentiers who find its Collapse-era worlds more authentic than any documentary. Sessions can last up to 72 simulated hours.
story_hooks: A player doing a 72-hour Lagos Flood scenario refuses to log out — their body is in a neural pod in a Tier 3 gaming lounge but their mind seems to have locked into the sim.
A historian discovers that one of TOTAL RECALL's 'historical archetype' lives is actually a direct copy of a real person's BCI memory scan — someone who never consented.
The Twenty-Twentiers have found a glitch in bootleg TOTAL RECALL copies that lets players step outside the scripted scenarios into something that doesn't look like historical data.
